pareto_front.connection: straight segments between distinct front coordinates sorted by FPS; no interpolation claim
pareto_front.dominance: B dominates A iff FPS_B >= FPS_A and energy_B <= energy_A, with at least one strict inequality
pareto_front.equal_coordinates: retain every UID; equal coordinates do not dominate each other
pareto_front.population: all observed deployments with finite FPS and energy, including both Full alternatives
pareto_front.runner_front_scope: Native or Generic splits only, within the same model/setup
